newsitem.title: HONDURAS: SOCER-HONDURAN PLAYER EMIGRATES AFTER THREATS.
newsitem.headline: SOCER-HONDURAN PLAYER EMIGRATES AFTER THREATS.

text.p: Honduran soccer player Richardson Smith said on Thursday he was moving to a new club in neighbouring El Salvador after receiving threats from irate fans over a World Cup error which cost his national team a goal.
"I am doing this with the consent of my club president Jose Yacaman and for my own personal security," Smith told reporters.

Earlier this month midfielder Smith made a mistake in a World Cup qualifying match against Mexico, losing the ball on the edge of the penalty area and allowing Mexico to score one of their three goals in the match. Honduras ended up losing 3-1.
The same night irate fans attacked his home with fireworks and rocks.
Smith said he was leaving Marathon of Honduras and joining Luis Angel Firpo of El Salvador.
